description:
Adds Nutrilio Local backup & restore: a button on the Backup screen that opens Nutrilios built-in local file backup/restore. Exports all entries, images and settings to a portable .nutrilio file (a ZIP) via share; restores from a picked file. No Google account or premium needed. Plus existing SonyLIV, Threads and Arrow Puzzle patches.

Verified: morphe-cli applies; baksmali confirms the injection + merged extension. Runtime not device-verified.
